title: Setup: the Create User and Set Password params are declared type text, so the admin's typed password shows in clear text
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-10** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin; Users → Create User, and row menu → Set Password.
- **Actual:** "Password (leave empty to generate)" / "New Password" are `<input type="text">`; the typed password is readable on screen and in screenshots.
- **Evidence:** [`07-F-users-create-password-plaintext.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-F-users-create-password-plaintext.png), [`07-people-users-action-set_user_password.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-people-users-action-set_user_password.png).
- **class: b.** **Reach:** every admin creating users or resetting passwords.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `plugin-auth` action params (`create_user`, `set_user_password`) / console param renderer.
- **Dedupe words:** password input type text, plaintext password field.

## Seat review

- **Seat's class:** a (hardening), not b. The password is the admin's own input, and it is not shown to anyone else.
- **Landing (seat review):** `packages/platform-objects` `sys-user.object.ts` declares the params `type: 'text'`. This is not the renderer bug fixed in objectui#5322.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 + 1 hits in objectstack, 2 in objectui. objectui#5322 was a renderer bug, closed. **New.**
